verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stripe Billing/Invoicing can create, customize, and automatically send hosted invoices from the Dashboard (stripe-billing-docs-8), but the evidence never explicitly documents sequential invoice numbering, credit notes, receipts, or memo/custom-field compliance details, and a community comment even claims Stripe historically lacked easy 'email invoicing' compared to competitors (stripe-billing-comm-6). missing for 10: explicit documentation of sequential numbering, credit note generation, receipt issuance, and memo/custom field support with independent corroboration that these are compliant and automated end-to-end.
